# 前沿推进与低碳

_Advanced Propulsion & Decarbonization_

跟踪电推进、混合电推进、氢能和可持续航空燃料，并区分概念、试验与实际应用。

_Track electrified propulsion, hydrogen and sustainable aviation fuels, while distinguishing concepts, tests and operational use._

## 主题分支 / Topics

- [混合电推进与系统集成 / Hybrid-Electric Propulsion & Integration](#books/wiki?page=230)
- [氢能与可持续航空燃料 / Hydrogen & Sustainable Aviation Fuels](#books/wiki?page=231)

## 阅读建议 / Study Approach

先读专题导读，再查原始资料；把概念、工况和证据范围一起记录。

_Read the topic notes, then consult the original material. Keep concepts, operating conditions and the scope of evidence together._

## 资料与来源 / Resources & Sources

- **电气化航空推进 / Electrified Aircraft Propulsion**（NASA, Topic） · [官方来源 / Source](https://www.nasa.gov/mission/eap/)

_Official entry points for technologies, aircraft concepts, test facilities and publications._

- **电气化推进构型 / Electrified Propulsion Architectures**（NASA, Web） · [官方来源 / Source](https://www.nasa.gov/eap-aircraft-concepts/aircraft-configurations/)

比较全电、混合电和涡轮电推进的能量路径。

_Compare the energy paths in all-electric, hybrid-electric and turboelectric arrangements._

- **氢与航空燃料双燃料飞机 / Dual Hydrogen–Jet-Fuel Aircraft**（NASA NTRS, 2023） · [官方来源 / Source](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20230009244)

- **NASA / Boeing 可持续航空燃料排放测量 / Sustainable Aviation Fuel Emissions Measurements**（NASA, 2023） · [官方来源 / Source](https://www.nasa.gov/aeronautics/nasa-boeing-gather-data-to-aid-sustainable-aviation-fuel-adoption-2/)
